kubernetes_kubernetes.ceiling_type: scraping-ceiling (mining saturated: only 22 new in-corpus pairs at current patterns; 0-1 out-of-corpus refs because the corpus is a strict number prefix)

microsoft_vscode.ceiling_type: scraping-ceiling + mining-channel mismatch (corpus covers 2.8% of the repo; dup targets live in comments — 49% recovery — not bodies — 0 hits)
microsoft_vscode.path: label-targeted scrape of *duplicate issues + comment/timeline target extraction; candidate ceiling ~14188 pairs vs 2023 needed at 80% power
caveats: conditions on the observed +10pp being real — the W3 vscode CI includes zero, so this is unproven, not demonstrated
dup-channel pairs are near-identical issues — easier retrieval targets than the current gold mix; the retry eval stands on the new corpus's own CI, not on comparability with W3's +10pp

verdict.overall: GO (both repos) — vscode is scraping-ceilinged, not structurally ceilinged; its 411-pair constraint was an artifact of scraping the wrong slice and mining the wrong channel.
